children: are expanding their Fire TV partnership to give brands access to advertising space on Insignia televisions, the companies said on Wednesday.

Under the expanded multiyear agreement, Best Buy Ads will offer brands access to Fire TV advertising inventory across new and existing Insignia TVs. Starting in February 2027, Best Buy Ads will use Amazon Ads’
programmatic technology, including AI-powered tools, to help brands plan, run, improve, and measure advertising campaigns.
The companies said the partnership will allow brands to use video and display ads on Fire TV and get insights into how their campaigns perform.
Fire TV will remain the exclusive TV software on all Insignia TVs made by Best Buy
. The TVs range from 24-inch to 85-inch models and include the latest Fire TV interface. Alexa+ is also integrated into most models.
will continue to be the exclusive retailer for Insignia TVs in its stores and on Amazon.com
, where the products are sold by Best Buy.
began their partnership in 2018, when they introduced Insignia and Toshiba smart TVs with Fire TV built in. Since then, the companies have introduced more than 100 TV models.
reported more than $41.6 billion in fiscal 2026 revenue and operates more than 1,000 retail stores in North America.

title: Best Buy, Amazon expand Fire TV deal to add advertising
